title: A breathe of fresh air
text: This was an excellent adventure with a fantastic guide, Carlos! The views from the ride were stunning, the people were warm and friendly, and the choice between town or beach was a great option.
author: Nina_S

title: Fun getaway outside the city - relaxing day and great guide!
text:
We needed a getaway from monuments and cathedrals and this was perfect. Horseback riding with Hipica Pasadoble showed us beautiful scenery in Donana park. Then we spent some much needed relaxing time on the beach and got lunch at a local beach restaurant. We finished with a stop at El Rocia to learn about the wild horses and pilgrimage. Carlos was our guide and made sure every detail was perfect. He treated us like family and was above and beyond helpful. Super big shout out to Carlos for a great day!

author: Cinkevk1

title: Awesome day trip from Seville!
text: We had a wonderful day trip to Donana National Park! Carlos was an excellent guide, very friendly and knowledgeable. He was very flexible with plans for the day, so we could enjoy some time relaxing on the beach and swimming in the ocean and have lunch right by the beach. The horse ride through the dunes and along the coast was beautiful and we really enjoyed visiting El Rocio and seeing the wild horses there as well!
author: H6785IHjenniferw
